description: Find tokens by category, live code, real fees, or an on-chain signal, e.g. “DePIN tokens with live code” or “tokens whose market cap is mostly paper”. Signals cover the top 1000: thin = real cap under half the market cap (order books too shallow for its size), unbacked = under half the volume venues report is carried by their order books (on $1M+ a day), unlocks = next 30 days of vesting worth more than a day of trading, heated = open interest at 30%+ of market cap or funding beyond ±0.05% per 8h, mint = the owner can mint, whales = ten wallets hold half the supply, fakes = copies under its ticker whose owner can take or freeze tokens.
